instruction: Copy the "Total Expenses" column along with the header to a new sheet named "Sheet2".

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully copied the Revenue column (A1:A20) to a new Sheet2 by selecting the column, right-clicking the sheet tab to insert a new sheet, and pasting the data.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can select columns, create new sheets, copy-paste data between sheets in LibreOffice Calc
metadata.task_rationale: Same copy-column-to-new-sheet pattern but targeting a different column (Total Expenses instead of Revenue)
metadata.explanation: Task requires copying column B (Total Expenses) with header to Sheet2. Evaluator checks Sheet2 exists with correct header and all 19 expense values.

scoring_breakdown.header: 0.2 - Correct header 'Total Expenses' in Sheet2 A1

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads column A from Sheet2, which is the natural destination when copying a column to a new sheet
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses 'expected_header' and 'expected_values' from the rules dict
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads, ensuring data is persisted to disk
Partial credit scoring is well-designed: 0.2 for header, 0.8 proportional for values
Python int==float comparison (e.g., 10828 == 10828.0) returns True, so no type mismatch risk with openpyxl
All 19 expected values and header are checked, providing complete coverage of the instruction requirements
